projects.name: Analytics Dashboard Platform
projects.description:
A unified analytics dashboard that ingests customer CSV files, analyzes application logs, and presents results through reusable visualization components. Scope covers data processing pipelines, log analysis, front-end visualization, application integration, and launch readiness.

Structure: five milestone-level tasks, each decomposed into leaf tasks with complexity kept at 6 or below so every task is independently executable.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1: Customer CSV Data Processing Pipeline
tasks.details:
Milestone covering ingestion, validation, transformation, and loading of customer CSV files into the analytics store. Deliverable: repeatable pipeline that accepts raw CSV uploads, validates against a versioned schema, rejects malformed rows with actionable error reports, and stages clean customer records for dashboard consumption.

Acceptance criteria:
- Versioned CSV schema contract documented with sample fixtures
- Parser handles encoding, delimiter, and type edge cases
- Idempotent, incremental loads with deduplication
- Data quality checks surface issues before they reach dashboards
- Pipeline covered by unit and integration tests

tasks.name: M2: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details:
Milestone covering parsing, enrichment, and aggregation of application log data into queryable analytics metrics. Deliverable: a log pipeline that ingests structured and semi-structured logs, normalizes them, computes operational metrics (error rates, latency percentiles, throughput), and evaluates alert rules.

Acceptance criteria:
- Documented log format specification and parsing rules
- Ingestion handles rotation, late-arriving entries, and backfill
- Aggregations produce error-rate, latency, and volume metrics
- Alert/anomaly rules configurable and testable
- Pipeline covered by unit and integration tests

tasks.name: M3: Visualization Component Library
tasks.details:
Milestone covering the reusable chart, KPI, filter, and table components that render analytical data. Deliverable: a documented, accessible component library consumed by the dashboard application shell.

Acceptance criteria:
- Design tokens and theming defined (color, typography, spacing)
- Chart primitives support line/bar/stacked and time-series data
- KPI cards, filters, and a log explorer table available
- Components responsive and WCAG 2.1 AA aligned
- Storybook (or equivalent) examples for each component

tasks.name: M5: Quality, Launch Readiness & Operations
tasks.details:
Milestone covering end-to-end testing, CI/CD automation, performance validation, deployment, and post-launch observability. Deliverable: production-ready release with automated quality gates and operational runbooks.

Acceptance criteria:
- End-to-end test suite covers critical dashboard journeys
- CI pipeline runs lint, unit, integration, and E2E gates
- Performance validated against agreed latency budgets
- Deployment automated with rollback path and monitoring/alerting
- User and operator documentation published

tasks.name: M4: Dashboard Application Shell & API Integration
tasks.details:
Milestone covering the application shell, routing, data access layer, and wiring of visualization components to pipeline-backed APIs. Deliverable: working dashboard application where users can navigate views and see live customer and log metrics.

Acceptance criteria:
- API contract documented and data access layer implemented
- App shell with routing, layout, and global filters
- Visualization components wired to real API responses
- Authentication and role-based view access enforced
- Loading, empty, and error states handled consistently

tasks.name: M1.1 Document CSV schema contract and sample fixtures
tasks.details:
Define the versioned customer CSV schema: field names, types, nullability, allowed value ranges, encoding (UTF-8 with BOM handling), and delimiter policy. Produce representative sample files covering clean rows, missing optional fields, malformed rows, and duplicate primary keys.

Deliverable: schema spec document in repo plus a fixtures directory used by tests.
Done when: schema reviewed and fixtures committed.

tasks.name: M1.2 Build CSV parser and row-level validator
tasks.details:
Implement the CSV reading layer: streaming parse, header mapping, type coercion, and per-row validation against the M1.1 schema. Collect malformed rows into a structured error report (row number, field, reason) instead of failing the whole file.

Done when: parser handles quoted fields, embedded newlines, encoding variants, and returns a typed record stream plus error report. Unit tests cover each edge case.

tasks.name: M1.3 Build staged loader with batch lineage
tasks.details:
Write validated records into a staging table and record lineage metadata: source file name, file hash, load timestamp, and batch ID. Support incremental batch loads. Deduplication logic is handled separately in M1.6.

Done when: a clean fixture loads into staging, lineage columns are populated for every row, and an integration test proves two sequential batches coexist.

tasks.name: M1.4 Add data quality checks and error reporting
tasks.details:
Add pre-load quality gates: required-field completeness, referential sanity, duplicate detection, and outlier/range checks. Emit a per-run quality report (counts of accepted, rejected, and flagged rows) and expose it to operators.

Done when: a deliberately corrupt sample file produces a readable quality report and is blocked from promotion to curated tables.

tasks.name: M1.5 Write CSV pipeline unit and integration tests
tasks.details:
Cover the parser, validator, loader, and quality checks with unit tests, plus one end-to-end integration test that runs a sample file from disk through staging to curated output. Target meaningful coverage of failure paths, not just happy path.

Done when: tests run in CI, pass reliably, and cover malformed input, duplicates, and replay scenarios.

tasks.name: M2.1 Write log format specification and parsing rules
tasks.details:
Document the application log formats in scope (structured JSON lines and semi-structured text), including timestamp formats, severity levels, request IDs, and known malformed patterns. Define normalization rules mapping source fields to a canonical event schema.

Done when: spec published in repo with annotated real-world log samples.

tasks.name: M2.2 Build log ingestion with rotation and backfill support
tasks.details:
Implement ingestion that follows rotated files, tracks offsets/checkpoints, tolerates late-arriving entries, and supports bounded historical backfill without reprocessing duplicates. Normalize records into the canonical event schema from M2.1.

Done when: ingestion resumes correctly after restart, handles a rotated file sequence, and backfills a date range idempotently.

tasks.name: M2.3 Implement metric aggregation jobs
tasks.details:
Compute windowed operational metrics from normalized log events: request volume, error rate by severity and endpoint, and latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99). Store pre-aggregated rollups at minute and hour granularity for fast dashboard queries.

Done when: rollups reconcile against raw event counts and are queryable by time range and service.

tasks.name: M2.4 Build alert rule configuration and validation
tasks.details:
Define a declarative rule schema covering threshold rules (error rate above X), baseline-deviation rules, and silence/maintenance windows. Validate rules at load time with actionable error messages and ship a set of example rule files.

Done when: invalid rule config fails fast with a clear message and valid configs parse into typed rule objects with unit tests.

tasks.name: M2.5 Write log pipeline tests and fixtures
tasks.details:
Cover parsing, normalization, ingestion checkpointing, aggregation math, and rule evaluation with unit tests. Add an integration test that replays a small fixture log set through ingestion to rollups and asserts expected metric values.

Done when: tests run in CI and cover malformed log lines, rotation, backfill, and alert firing/non-firing.

tasks.name: M3.1 Define design tokens and theming
tasks.details:
Establish the visual foundation: color palette (including a categorical series palette that is colorblind-safe), typography scale, spacing scale, elevation, and light/dark theme values. Export tokens in a format consumable by the component library and charting layer.

Done when: tokens are published as a package and documented with usage guidance.

tasks.name: M3.2 Build chart primitive components
tasks.details:
Implement line, bar, stacked bar, and area chart primitives with a shared prop contract for series data, axes, legends, tooltips, and time bucketing. Keep the charting engine behind an adapter so the library can be swapped later.

Done when: each primitive renders from typed props, handles empty and single-point datasets, and has documented examples.

tasks.name: M3.3 Build KPI cards and filter controls
tasks.details:
Create KPI card components (value, delta, trend sparkline, threshold state) and filter controls (date range picker, service/segment multi-select, search input) with a controlled-state API so the shell can own filter state.

Done when: components are keyboard operable, accept controlled and uncontrolled modes, and have examples in the component gallery.

tasks.name: M3.4 Build log explorer table component
tasks.details:
Implement a virtualized table for log events with server-driven sorting, column configuration, severity badges, expandable detail rows, and pagination. Must stay responsive with 10k+ row datasets through windowing rather than full render.

Done when: sorting and pagination are delegated to the data layer, row expansion works, and a large-dataset benchmark shows acceptable interaction latency.

tasks.name: M3.5 Accessibility and responsive hardening with component gallery
tasks.details:
Audit all components for WCAG 2.1 AA: focus states, ARIA roles for charts and tables, color contrast, reduced-motion support, and screen-reader text alternatives for data visuals. Add responsive breakpoints so dashboards degrade gracefully from desktop to tablet.

Done when: automated axe checks pass and the component gallery documents each component's a11y behavior.

tasks.name: M4.1 Document API contract and build data access layer
tasks.details:
Define the dashboard API contract (endpoints, query params, pagination, error envelope) for customer metrics and log metrics. Implement a typed client/data access layer with request cancellation, retry policy, and response caching.

Done when: contract is documented, types are generated or hand-written and shared, and the client has unit tests against mocked responses.

tasks.name: M4.2 Build app shell, routing, and global filter state
tasks.details:
Scaffold the dashboard application: layout regions, navigation, route definitions for customer view, log/metrics view, and log explorer. Lift date-range and segment filters into a shared state container persisted to the URL.

Done when: navigating between routes preserves filter context and deep links restore the same view state.

tasks.name: M4.3 Wire dashboard views to APIs with loading, empty, and error states
tasks.details:
Connect the visualization components to the data access layer for each view: customer KPIs and trends, log error-rate and latency charts, and the log explorer. Implement skeleton loaders, empty-state messaging, and retryable error banners so no view renders blank on failure.

Done when: each view renders real data end to end and all three non-happy states are demonstrated.

tasks.name: M4.4 Integrate identity provider and session handling
tasks.details:
Wire up the chosen identity provider: login/callback flow, token storage and refresh, logout, and session expiry handling. Redirect unauthenticated users away from protected routes. Role enforcement is handled separately in M4.5.

Done when: a user can log in, stay signed in across refresh, and be cleanly logged out on expiry; covered by an auth integration test.

tasks.name: M5.1 Build end-to-end test suite for critical journeys
tasks.details:
Automate the critical user journeys: load dashboard, change date range, drill into customer segment, open log explorer and filter by severity, and verify alert display. Run against seeded test data in a staging environment.

Done when: E2E suite runs headlessly in CI with stable selectors and produces artifacts (screenshots/traces) on failure.

tasks.name: M5.2 Set up CI pipeline with quality gates
tasks.details:
Create the CI workflow: dependency install with caching, lint and typecheck, unit tests, integration tests, and E2E stage. Block merges on failing gates and publish coverage and test reports.

Done when: pipeline runs on every pull request in under a target duration and a deliberately failing test blocks merge.

tasks.name: M5.3 Performance profiling and optimization
tasks.details:
Profile dashboard load and query performance against agreed budgets (e.g. p95 view load, API latency, log explorer interaction). Optimize the top bottlenecks: query indexes, rollup usage, bundle splitting, and chart render cost.

Done when: documented baseline and post-optimization numbers meet the budgets, with a repeatable benchmark script.

tasks.name: M5.4 Automate deployment with one-step rollback
tasks.details:
Create deployment pipelines for staging and production with environment-specific configuration, versioned artifacts, and a one-command rollback to the previous release. Rehearse a deploy-and-rollback cycle in staging.

Done when: staging deploy and rollback both complete successfully and are documented step by step.

tasks.name: M5.5 Write user and operator documentation
tasks.details:
Produce end-user docs (dashboard tour, filter usage, metric definitions) and operator docs (how to trigger a CSV load, interpret quality reports, tune alert rules). Keep metric definitions single-sourced from the pipeline specs.

Done when: docs are published in the team wiki with screenshots and a glossary of metrics.

tasks.name: M1.6 Add replay-safe deduplication to the loader
tasks.details:
Add an upsert keyed on customer ID plus source-file hash so re-running the same file never creates duplicate rows. Define the conflict-resolution policy for changed records and add the supporting unique constraint/index.

Done when: loading the same file twice yields identical row counts and a changed-record scenario resolves per the documented policy.

tasks.name: M2.6 Implement alert evaluation and notification dedup
tasks.details:
Evaluate validated rules on a schedule against aggregated rollups, track alert state transitions (ok to firing to resolved), and suppress duplicate notifications while an alert stays open. Emit a structured alert payload for downstream delivery.

Done when: tests prove an alert fires once per state transition, respects silence windows, and auto-resolves.

tasks.name: M4.5 Enforce role-based route and data access
tasks.details:
Map identity claims to application roles (e.g. analyst, admin), add route guards and conditional component visibility, and enforce the same rules server-side on API endpoints so the UI is not the only barrier. Provide a clear 403 experience.

Done when: access tests pass for each role and a lower-privileged user is blocked both in the UI and at the API.

tasks.name: M5.6 Set up monitoring and write the operations runbook
tasks.details:
Configure uptime and error monitoring for the dashboard, freshness alerts for both pipelines, and basic usage metrics. Write the operations runbook covering failed CSV loads, stalled log ingestion, alert storms, and rollback procedure.

Done when: a synthetic failure triggers the expected alert and an operator can follow the runbook end to end.
